notes: v5.2.2 is a consolidation/reproducibility release; no hot-patching of the active install is part of the release procedure.
Promise plugin adapter uses Plugin.define when available and raw default compatibility only when the SDK lacks that named export.
Nested behavioral canary is state-driven: the fixture requires Delivery and the expected route remains strictly Project Manager -> Tracker Operator.
Plugin-list startup recovery is bounded and never treats a missing plugin as success.
Core Runtime, deterministic Contract Assurance, and strict model-driven Behavioral Canary remain separate validation layers.
